entries.snippet: The agency says that they "appear to be pressure vessels from a space launch vehicle".

entries.snippet: Nigeria's government said one of its nationals was reportedly killed by police officers "using gruesome interrogation techniques".

entries.title: Trump, Mamdani give contrasting July 4th speeches. And, U.S. faces Belgium in World Cup
entries.snippet: For the nation's 250th birthday, President Trump and NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani had opposing visions of America. And, the U.S. and Belgium face off today in the FIFA World Cup.

entries.title: These Medicare beneficiaries thought their drug plan was free. Then they lost it
entries.snippet: Thousands of people lost coverage over as little as $8 in delinquent payments. They didn't know their zero-dollar premiums had gone up and they owed money. Most now can't get coverage until 2027.

entries.title: Hate food waste? 7 creative ways to turn your leftovers into a new meal
entries.snippet: We asked our audience to share their favorite go-to recipes for leftovers. Here are seven dishes — like stuffed peppers and a biryani casserole — that can help you use up all your fridge scraps.

entries.title: Marriage used to be a glide path to citizenship. Now there are more speed bumps
entries.snippet: Spouses of U.S. citizens have traditionally had a special place in immigration law. That's no longer the case, according to the administration and immigration lawyers.

entries.title: Fast walkers in their 80s cut their risk of cognitive decline by half, a study finds
entries.snippet: A new study of people 80 and older with exceptional gaits finds fast walkers have about a 50% lower risk of cognitive decline, showing the connection between physical health and brain health.

entries.title: The U.S. faces Belgium in the World Cup on the heels of Trump-Infantino red card call
entries.snippet: The U.S. striker Folarin Balogun is expected to start against Belgium in a Round of 16 match after a surprise decision by FIFA to allow him to play despite receiving a red card last week.

entries.title: Russian missile and drone attack on Ukraine's capital kills at least 12
entries.snippet: Russia launched waves of missiles and drones at Kyiv early Monday, killing at least 12 people in an attack that exposed widening gaps in Ukraine's air defenses, authorities said.

entries.title: Trump won spending promises from NATO last year. This week, he'll try to enforce them
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump is heading to Ankara, Turkey, for the annual NATO summit. Last year, he pushed NATO allies to spend more on defense. This year, his mission is to try to enforce those pledges.

entries.title: Mexico's World Cup run ends with loss to England at Estadio Azteca
entries.snippet: Playing at altitude with the passionate backing of 80,824 fans at Estadio Azteca, and with a man advantage for most of the second half, Mexico scored twice but could never equalize and lost 3-2.

entries.title: Y si sí: the phrase uniting Mexico during the World Cup
entries.snippet: Mexico's World Cup run has inspired a phrase heard across the country: "Y si sí." Or in English: "What if we can?" Anamaria Sayre reports from Mexico City.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Trump officially launches Trump Accounts for kids, ringing Wall Street opening bell
entries.snippet: With high inflation hurting Trump's popularity, the Republican president has tried to get more Americans to focus on their 401(k) investments, claiming that his policies should get the credit for any gains, particularly as the November midterm elections draw closer.

entries.title: White House report brands Smithsonian leadership as radical activists who can't be trusted
entries.snippet: The report released late on Independence Day by the White House Domestic Policy Council comes in the midst of Trump's aggressive campaign to overhaul some of Washington's most sacred cultural and historic institutions.

entries.title: AP report: FIFA lifts U.S. player Balogun's red card suspension at World Cup after Trump calls Infantino
entries.snippet: "Thank you to FIFA for doing what was right, and reversing a great injustice!" Trump said in a statement on social media.

entries.title: National Guard members on patrol in Memphis fatally shoot man during pursuit, police say

entries.title: 7 OPEC+ countries agree to expand monthly oil production modestly as prices slide
entries.snippet: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies announced on Sunday that seven countries would expand oil production by a combined total of 188,000 barrels per day in August.

entries.title: Democrat Mallory McMorrow suspends her Michigan Senate campaign and scrambles the pivotal race
entries.snippet: McMorrow's exit comes after many Democrats increasingly viewed her as a long shot for the nomination. It also creates a fresh dynamic in one of the country's most closely watched Senate races.

entries.title: Unbearable heat suspected in 19 New Jersey deaths as high temperatures give way to thunderstorms

entries.snippet: Since he started work as NATO secretary-general almost two years ago, Mark Rutte has spent much of his time trying to keep the United States anchored to the world's biggest military alliance.

entries.title: Residents in eastern Congo cling to hope as a new Ebola treatment trial begins
entries.snippet: At the Ebola treatment center inside Bunia's Evangelical Medical Center, in eastern Congo's Ituri province, the launch of the research was marked by urgency rather than ceremony.

entries.title: Trump's administration won't seek new bids to repair the Reflecting Pool

entries.snippet: The funeral was in part a show of unity and defiance as Iran demands a measure of control over the Strait of Hormuz, a vital waterway for global energy that it shut down during the war.

entries.snippet: Speaking in Washington after storms prompted a roughly two-hour evacuation of the National Mall, Trump honored veterans, including several from World War II and one of the first Black officers to lead a Special Forces team in combat in Vietnam.

entries.snippet: Authorities urged residents in parts of Thessaloniki, Greece's second largest city, to remain indoors and shut their windows and doors due to toxic smoke from a burning recycling plant that was engulfed by a wildfire.

entries.title: Fireworks, heat, hot dogs and politics: America celebrates its 250th birthday
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump plans to speak on the National Mall before what is being billed as a historically enormous fireworks show that will rain down over the nation's capital.

entries.title: A child can drown in seconds. Doctors want more families to be prepared
entries.snippet: About 4,000 to 5,000 Americans drown each year. Most are adults who die in natural bodies of water, such as lakes, ponds or oceans.

entries.title: Pope marks July 4 by praying in Lampedusa for migrants who died seeking freedom and prosperity

entries.title: Far-right Alternative for Germany party reelects leaders as protesters and police clash
entries.snippet: Alternative for Germany, or AfD, sought to show unity as it voted to extend the terms of Alice Weidel and Tino Chrupalla, who have headed it for four years as co-leaders and ran unopposed Saturday.

entries.title: Philippine Senate launches impeachment trial of Sara Duterte
entries.snippet: The trial against Sara Duterte is the latest escalation in a bitter feud between the Philippines' leading political dynasties. The proceedings could have major implications for the country's 2028 presidential elections.

entries.title: World Cup 2026: Trump, FIFA and the Balogun controversy
entries.snippet: One of the few certainties of World Cup football has been rocked after Donald Trump lobbied FIFA to overturn a US red card suspension. The decision has caused outrage but it isn't completely without precedent.

entries.title: Sri Lanka prison clashes leave dozens dead

entries.title: Hamas to dissolve Gaza governing body

entries.title: Fashion against fascism: When trademarks deter neo-Nazis

entries.snippet: After a yearlong flight of a billion kilometers, a Chinese space probe is set to take samples from an asteroid. The mission is part of what President Xi Jinping calls the country's "space dream."

entries.title: European space telescope Euclid spots oldest quasars yet
entries.snippet: Think of quasars as time machines. Rare but revealing. They are light from the beginnings of the universe that let astronomers investigate how early galaxies formed.

entries.title: Australia, Fiji sign defense pact to counter China in Pacific

entries.title: Ukraine: Several killed in renewed attacks on Kyiv

entries.title: Super Typhoon Bavi hits US Pacific islands

entries.title: World Cup: Trump thanks FIFA for suspending Balogun's red card ban

entries.title: Far-right AfD reaffirms ambition to govern Germany

entries.title: Wildfires rage in Portugal, Greece, France and Spain

entries.title: Turkey steps up arrests ahead of NATO summit
entries.snippet: Journalists, academics and members of left-wing groups have reportedly been detained during police raids in several Turkish provinces. Turkey's capital Ankara is set to host a major NATO summit this week.
